articles.title_en: When Sarah Meets Lawrence: The Effects of Coeducation on Women’s College Major Choices
articles.title_cn: 当莎拉遇见劳伦斯：男女同校对女性大学专业选择的影响
articles.abstract_en: We leverage variation in the adoption of coeducation by US women’s colleges to study how exposure to a mixed-gender collegiate environment affects women’s human capital investments. Our event-study analyses of newly collected historical data find a 3.0–3.5 percentage point (30–33 percent) decline in the share of women majoring in STEM fields. While coeducation caused a large influx of male peers and a modest increase in male faculty, we find no evidence that it altered the composition of the female student body or other gender-neutral inputs. Extrapolation of our main estimate suggests that coeducational environments explain 36 percent of the current gender gap in STEM majors. (JEL I23, I26, J16, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国女子学院采用男女同校教育的差异来研究接触混合性别大学环境如何影响女性的人力资本投资。我们对新收集的历史数据进行的事件研究分析发现，女性选择STEM专业的比例下降了3.0-3.5个百分点（30-33%）。虽然男女同校导致了大量男性同龄人的涌入和男性教师的适度增加，但我们没有发现证据表明它改变了女性学生群体的构成或其他性别中性的投入。我们主要估计的外推表明，男女同校环境解释了当前STEM专业性别差距的36%。（JEL I23, I26, J16, J24）

articles.title_en: Uncovering Peer Effects in Social and Academic Skills
articles.title_cn: 揭示社交与学业技能中的同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of adolescent peers who are central in their social network on the formation of social skills and academic performance of fellow students. I conduct a novel large-scale field experiment at selective public boarding schools in Peru with two treatments: (i) more socially central versus less socially central peers, and (ii) higher-achieving versus lower-achieving peers. Peer effects are more pronounced for social skills than academic performance, and both vary by gender. While socially central peers lead boys to better social skills, higher-achieving peers decrease girls' test scores. Gender differences in self-confidence can explain both findings. (JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在社交网络中处于中心地位的青少年同伴对同伴学生社交技能形成和学业表现的影响。我在秘鲁的精英公立寄宿学校进行了一项新颖的大规模实地实验，包含两种处理：（i）社交中心性较高与较低的同伴，以及（ii）学业成绩较高与较低的同伴。同伴效应对社交技能的影响比对学业表现更为显著，且两者均因性别而异。社交中心性高的同伴能提升男生的社交技能，而学业成绩高的同伴则降低了女生的考试成绩。性别在自信心上的差异可以解释这两个发现。（JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13）

articles.title_en: Does Discipline Decrease Police Misconduct? Evidence from Chicago Civilian Allegations
articles.title_cn: 纪律处分是否会减少警察不当行为？来自芝加哥平民指控的证据
articles.abstract_en: Reformers are calling for greater oversight of police behavior, in part through enhanced use of civilian complaints. However, others counter that greater oversight could chill effective policing. We assess police officer response to administrative determinations of misconduct. Using Chicago data, we find strong evidence that a sustained allegation reduces that officer’s future misconduct. We find no evidence that this effect is driven by incapacitation, such as assignment to desk duty, or by officer disengagement. We conclude that our findings are most consistent with improved officer conduct, in part from oversight and officer concerns over promotion, salary, and desirable assignments. (JEL H76, J45, K42, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 改革者呼吁加强对警察行为的监督，部分通过增强对平民投诉的使用。然而，其他人反驳说，加强监督可能会抑制有效的警务工作。我们评估了警察对行政不当行为认定的反应。利用芝加哥的数据，我们发现强有力的证据表明，持续的指控会减少该警官未来的不当行为。我们没有发现证据表明这种效应是由失能（如被分配到文职工作）或警官脱离工作所驱动的。我们得出结论，我们的发现与警官行为的改善最为一致，部分原因在于监督以及警官对晋升、薪水和理想工作安排的担忧。（JEL H76, J45, K42, M54）

articles.title_en: Halfway Home? Residential Housing and Reincarceration
articles.title_cn: 中途之家？住宅住房与再监禁
articles.abstract_en: Every year, hundreds of thousands of people are released from prison. For many, the transition back to society includes a mandatory stay in residential housing. I estimate the effect of residential housing on reincarceration using administrative data from Iowa. I address selection into residential housing by instrumenting for residential housing assignment with the recommendation rate of randomly assigned case managers. I find no evidence that Iowa’s costly investment in residential housing results in reduced reincarceration relative to parole. Instead, residential housing increases reincarceration due to violent crimes and technical violations, while decreasing drug and public order crimes. (JEL K42, R23, R31, R38)
articles.abstract_cn: 每年，数十万人从监狱获释。对许多人来说，重返社会的过渡包括强制性的住宅住房居住。我使用爱荷华州的行政数据估计住宅住房对再监禁的影响。我通过使用随机分配的案件管理员的推荐率作为住宅住房分配的工具变量来解决住宅住房的选择性问题。我没有发现证据表明爱荷华州在住宅住房上的昂贵投资相对于假释能减少再监禁。相反，住宅住房增加了因暴力犯罪和技术违规导致的再监禁，同时减少了毒品和公共秩序犯罪。（JEL K42, R23, R31, R38）

articles.title_cn: 现金保释能否遏制违法行为？
articles.abstract_en: Courts routinely use low cash bail as a financial incentive to ensure released defendants appear in court and abstain from crime. This can create burdens for defendants with little empirical evidence on its efficacy. We exploit a prosecutor-driven reform that led to a sharp reduction in low cash bail and pretrial supervision, with no effect on pretrial detention, to test whether such incentive mechanisms succeed at their intended purpose. We find no evidence that financial collateral has a deterrent effect on failure to appear or pretrial crime. This paper also contributes to the literature on legal actor discretion, showing that nonbinding reforms may have limited impact on jail populations. (JEL K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 法院通常使用低额现金保释作为经济激励，以确保被释放的被告出庭并避免犯罪。这可能给被告带来负担，而其有效性缺乏实证证据。我们利用一项由检察官推动的改革，该改革导致低额现金保释和审前监管大幅减少，但对审前拘留没有影响，以检验此类激励机制是否达到预期目的。我们没有发现财务抵押对未出庭或审前犯罪具有威慑作用的证据。本文还对法律行为者自由裁量权的文献做出了贡献，表明非约束性改革可能对监狱人口的影响有限。（JEL K41, K42）

articles.title_en: When Do Politicians Appeal Broadly? The Economic Consequences of Electoral Rules in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 政治家何时广泛诉求？巴西选举规则的经济后果
articles.abstract_en: Electoral rules determine how voters’ preferences are aggregated and translated into political representation. Using a regression discontinuity design, I contrast single- and two-round elections in Brazil. In two-round elections, the eventual winner must obtain at least 50 percent of the vote. I show that two-round elections provide incentives for candidates to secure a broader base of support and provide public goods more broadly. Candidates represent a more geographically diverse group of voters, public schools have more resources, and there is less variation in resources across schools. Effects appear to be driven by strategic responses of candidates rather than differential entry into races. (JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 选举规则决定了选民的偏好如何被汇总并转化为政治代表。利用断点回归设计，我对比了巴西的单轮和两轮选举。在两轮选举中，最终获胜者必须获得至少50%的选票。我表明，两轮选举激励候选人确保更广泛的支持基础，并更广泛地提供公共物品。候选人代表更地理多样化的选民群体，公立学校拥有更多资源，且学校间资源差异较小。这些效应似乎是由候选人的策略性回应而非参选者的差异进入所驱动。（JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17）

articles.title_en: School Attendance Boundaries and the Segregation of Public Schools in the United States
articles.title_cn: 学校招生边界与美国公立学校的隔离
articles.abstract_en: School segregation is determined both by residential sorting and local policies, such as the drawing of attendance boundaries and school siting. This paper develops an approach to understanding the relative importance of these factors by calculating the distance-minimizing assignment of students to schools and assessing whether actual assignments differ systematically by race. Using census data and attendance boundary maps for nearly 1,600 school districts, I find that attendance boundaries create 5 percent more integration than a distance-minimizing baseline, while school siting plays almost no role. Residential segregation alone explains more than 100 percent of school segregation in the United States. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 学校隔离既由居住分化决定，也由地方政策（如招生边界的划定和学校选址）决定。本文通过计算学生到学校距离最小化的分配方案，并评估实际分配是否因种族而存在系统性差异，提出了一种理解这些因素相对重要性的方法。利用近1,600个学区的普查数据和招生边界图，我发现招生边界比距离最小化基线多创造了5%的融合，而学校选址几乎不起作用。仅居住隔离就解释了美国学校隔离的100%以上。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23）

articles.title_en: Working Their Way Up? US Immigrants’ Changing Labor Market Assimilation in the Age of Mass Migration
articles.title_cn: 他们是否在向上流动？大规模移民时代美国移民劳动力市场同化的变迁
articles.abstract_en: Whether immigrants advance in labor markets during their lifetimes relative to natives is a fundamental question in the economics of immigration. We examine linked census records for five cohorts spanning 1850–1940, when immigration to the United States was at its peak. We find a U-shaped pattern of assimilation: immigrants were “catching up” to natives in the early and later cohorts, but not in between. This change was not due to shifts in immigrants’ source countries. Instead, it was rooted in men’s early-career occupations, which we associate with structural change, strengthening complementarities, and large immigration waves in the 1840s and 1900s. (JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)
articles.abstract_cn: 移民在其一生中相对于本地人在劳动力市场上是否有所进步，是移民经济学中的一个基本问题。我们考察了跨越1850-1940年的五个队列的关联人口普查记录，当时美国移民达到顶峰。我们发现同化呈U型模式：移民在早期和后期队列中“追赶”本地人，但在中间时期则不然。这一变化并非源于移民来源国的转变，而是根植于男性早期职业，我们将其与结构性变化、互补性增强以及1840年和1900年的大规模移民浪潮联系起来。(JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)

articles.title_en: From Hashtag to Hate Crime: Twitter and Antiminority Sentiment
articles.title_cn: 从标签到仇恨犯罪：推特与反少数族裔情绪
articles.abstract_en: We study whether social media can amplify antiminority sentiment with a focus on Donald Trump’s political rise. Using an instrumental variable strategy based on Twitter’s early adopters at the South by Southwest festival in 2007, we find that higher Twitter use in a county is associated with a sizeable increase in anti-Muslim hate crimes after the 2016 presidential primaries. Trump’s tweets about Muslims predict increases in xenophobic tweets by his followers, cable news mentions of Muslims, and hate crimes on the following days. These results suggest that social media content can affect real-life out-comes. (JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究社交媒体是否能放大反少数族裔情绪，重点关注唐纳德·特朗普的政治崛起。利用基于2007年西南偏南音乐节上推特早期采用者的工具变量策略，我们发现，一个县的推特使用率越高，2016年总统初选后反穆斯林仇恨犯罪的数量就越大。特朗普关于穆斯林的推文预测了其追随者仇外推文、有线新闻对穆斯林的提及以及随后几天仇恨犯罪的增加。这些结果表明，社交媒体内容可以影响现实生活中的结果。(JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)

articles.title_en: Adverse Selection in Low-Income Health Insurance Markets: Evidence from an RCT in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 低收入健康保险市场中的逆向选择：来自巴基斯坦随机对照试验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We present robust evidence on adverse selection in hospitalization insurance for low-income individuals that received first-time access to insurance. A large randomized control trial from Pakistan allows us to separate adverse selection from moral hazard, estimate how selection changes at different points of the demand curve, and test simple measures to limit adverse selection. The results reveal substantial selection in individual policies, leading to welfare losses and the threat of a market breakdown. Bundling insurance policies at the household level or higher almost eliminates adverse selection, thus mitigating its welfare consequences and facilitating sustainable insurance supply. (JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于低收入个体首次获得住院保险时逆向选择的稳健证据。一项来自巴基斯坦的大型随机对照试验使我们能够将逆向选择与道德风险区分开来，估计选择在不同需求曲线点上的变化，并测试限制逆向选择的简单措施。结果揭示了个人保单中存在显著的选择，导致福利损失和市场崩溃的威胁。在家庭层面或更高层面捆绑保险单几乎消除了逆向选择，从而减轻了其福利后果并促进了可持续的保险供给。(JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)

articles.title_en: What Difference Does a Health Plan Make? Evidence from Random Plan Assignment in Medicaid
articles.title_cn: 健康计划有何不同？来自医疗补助计划中随机计划分配的证据
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting the random assignment of Medicaid beneficiaries to managed care plans, we find substantial plan-specific spending effects despite plans having identical cost sharing. Enrollment in the lowest-spending plan reduces spending by at least 25 percent—primarily through quantity reductions—relative to enrollment in the highest-spending plan. Rather than reducing “wasteful” spending, lower-spending plans broadly reduce medical service provision—including the provision of low-cost, high-value care—and worsen beneficiary satisfaction and health. Consumer demand follows spending: a 10 percent increase in plan-specific spending is associated with a 40 percent increase in market share. These facts have implications for the government’s contracting problem and program cost growth. (JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用医疗补助受益人被随机分配到管理式护理计划的这一情况，我们发现尽管计划具有相同的成本分摊，但存在显著的特定计划支出效应。加入支出最低的计划相对于加入支出最高的计划，可使支出至少减少25%——主要通过数量减少实现。支出较低的计划并非减少“浪费性”支出，而是广泛减少了医疗服务提供——包括提供低成本、高价值的护理——并降低了受益人的满意度和健康状况。消费者需求随支出变化：特定计划支出增加10%与市场份额增加40%相关。这些事实对政府的签约问题和项目成本增长具有启示意义。(JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)

articles.title_en: Generic Aversion and Observational Learning in the Over-the-Counter Drug Market
articles.title_cn: 非处方药市场中的仿制药厌恶与观察学习
articles.abstract_en: Through a labeling intervention at a national retailer, we test three hypotheses for consumer aversion to generic over-the-counter drugs: lack of information on the comparability of generic and brand drugs, inattention to their price differences, and uncertainty about generic quality that can be reduced with information on peer purchase rates. With a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that posted information on the purchases of other customers increases generic purchase shares significantly, while other treatments have mixed results. Consumers without prior generic purchases appear particularly responsive to this information. These findings have policy implications for promoting evidence-based, cost-effective choices. (JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 通过在一家全国性零售商处进行的标签干预，我们检验了消费者对非处方仿制药厌恶的三个假设：缺乏关于仿制药和品牌药可比性的信息、对其价格差异的忽视，以及可以通过同伴购买率信息减少的仿制药质量不确定性。采用双重差分策略，我们发现张贴其他顾客购买信息显著提高了仿制药购买份额，而其他处理的效果不一。先前没有仿制药购买经历的消费者对这一信息似乎尤为敏感。这些发现对促进基于证据的、成本有效的选择具有政策意义。（JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37）
